replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: I've always found mathematics to be a bit challenging due to my primary school education. However, I appreciate its logical structure and how it helps me understand the world better. I use basic math daily, but advanced topics are still a struggle.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I do get anxious when faced with complex mathematical problems. My limited education background makes me feel inadequate, and I often worry about not being able to keep up with more advanced concepts.

To find the stationary points, you first need to find the derivative of the function y = f(x). Set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x. These solutions are the x-coordinates of the stationary points. To determine whether they are maxima or minima, you can use the second derivative test.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to reduce the dimensionality of data. It involves finding the directions (principal components) along which the data varies the most. You don't need to be anxious about its mathematics.
